hero.subtitle: Private Leagues for predicting CS2 Matches at the Major and other pro Events. Predictions stay hidden until everyone is in.

cta.note: Free to play · no money involved

demo.title: How Reveal works
demo.describe: Example Match showing how Reveal works. Predictions stay hidden until everyone has predicted or the Match Locks, then all of them are shown at once: two for Astralis and three for Falcons. Before that, three of five have predicted.

before.label: Before Lock
before.footer: 3 of 5 predicted · hidden until everyone predicts or Lock

league.title: Create a League
league.text: Choose an Event, name your League and share the Invite Link in your chat.

predict.title: Predict every Match
predict.text: One tap on the team you think will win. Change your mind until the Match Locks, 15 minutes before it starts.

reveal.title: Reveal together
reveal.text: Nobody sees your Prediction until everyone has predicted or the Match Locks. No copying.

leaderboard.title: Climb the Leaderboard
leaderboard.text: Points for every correct Prediction, and a separate Pick'em for each Stage.
